title: Extend consumed-name relevance to the harmless-import skip
outcome: An unresolved conditional Directory.Build import cannot be classified harmless when its document writes a property consumed only through live item metadata.
acceptance: A RED regression with HintPath/ReferenceOutputAssembly-only consumption and a late write reached through an unresolved-condition import demonstrates the skipped-input defect; the correction preserves explicit unresolved-condition refusal, while constant-false and genuinely irrelevant imports remain harmless.

Inventory all THREE relevance consumers: ProcessPropertyGroup group admission, its individual-property assignment filter (currently both share IsReferenceInputProperty), and ContainsDirectoryBuildSemanticFacts used by harmless-import skipping. Factor their common property-relevance decision into one shared predicate while preserving each caller's distinct role; do not duplicate a third agreeing expression.
Validate focused red/green controls, full gates, and independent review without broad missing-property assumptions; state parser versus public/native evidence explicitly.
